title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12
lineage: all transfers and work performed in the 24 bit realm Weiss-Saracon for 16 BIT 44.1kHz; SBE Free, Flac Level 8 with TLH, Meta Data with Tag & Rename
taper: Mystery Reel of an unknown audience recording uncovered  and shared by LL member Cloverman, which he sent to Matt Smith for his great reel transfer work.  The handwriting on the reel case is thought to be Latvala's, no more is known.

ai_review.summary: Acoustic set shines with How Long Blues and Attics, but the cassette‑sourced tape has modest sound quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the acoustic portion of this mysterious 1970 show, highlighting an “off‑the‑charts” dancing finale and calling out rare gems like How Long Blues and Attics as standouts. The recording is described as a definite “C” – a lo‑fi cassette source that is listenable but far from pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several highlighted acoustic moments outweighs the modest, cassette‑grade recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes a “definite C” sound – typical of low‑grade cassette tape with noticeable hiss and limited fidelity, but the performance remains clear enough to enjoy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set flows smoothly, building to an exuberant dancing climax; the overall vibe is nostalgic and energetic.
